title: Research: one-repeat partitioned (3,5)/(4,4) 8q priced obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Freestanding `#840`-style priced obstruction under [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898) at `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`. Names one-repeat companions of the partitioned `(3,5)` and `(4,4)` Hamilton layers at `Q=8`. Answers the remaining one-repeat companion question after [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) / pending `independent-walks-onerepeat-8q` `(2,6)`: do one-repeat layers on `(3,5)` or `(4,4)` improve on distinct-label floors `R=98` / `R=100`?

| Dual schedule | Covering pairs | Exact min R | Tariff floor (X≥0) | Undercuts 436? | Beats distinct? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Distinct `(3,5)` (#2851) | 10416000 | **98** | ≥500 | no | — |
| One-repeat `(3,5)` (this) | **2499840** | **112** | **≥528** | **no** | **no** |
| Distinct `(4,4)` (#2851) | 14165760 | **100** | ≥504 | no | — |
| One-repeat×distinct `(4,4)` (this) | **1666560** | **112** | **≥528** | **no** | **no** |
| One-repeat×one-repeat `(4,4)` | **0** | — | — | — | — |

Length-3 cannot host a one-repeat (closed zero edge). Abstract tariff `38·8+2·112=528>436`.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) / [#2846](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2846) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/independent-walks-onerepeat-35-44/`.
Tip: `8bd3d2985cfaef59d800409a283b2fbca15a4b73`.

Exact: one-repeat min R **112** on both shapes (tariff floor **528**); no undercut of 436; does not beat distinct 98/100.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-onerepeat-35-44/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/independent-walks-onerepeat-35-44/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-onerepeat-35-44/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-onerepeat-35-44/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-walks-onerepeat-35-44
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_ONEREPEAT_35_44_OBSTRUCTION one_repeat_35_min_R=112 one_repeat_44_min_R=112 ... tariff_floor=528 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_ONEREPEAT_35_44 covering_35=2499840 covering_44=1666560 ... tariff_floor=528 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_ONEREPEAT_35_44_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/independent-walks-onerepeat-35-44 outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

Closest prior: [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) (distinct partitioned Q=8), pending `independent-walks-onerepeat-8q` (one-repeat `(2,6)`), [#2846](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2846), [#2779](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2779). Freestanding `(3,5)`/`(4,4)` one-repeat layer; no competing open PR at refresh.
